cases.purpose: Observe controlled owned-process denied behavior in a private guest PID namespace.
cases.oracle: Same-process builtin preflight controls, native process-directory controls, task-bound syscall records and independently owned socket facts; apply the pinned data-only gate to complete raw evidence.
cases.comparison: Capture-only proposal. Validate pre-run prerequisites and each provisional trace with its matched teardown record; independent gate and safe enclosing runner are required before guest execution.
